name: 3008-solodecode-llama31-8b-8gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (same weights, same config); the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/completions, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42: prompts exactly 32 tokens (stdev 0), generations pinned at exactly 512 tokens with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on an eight-GPU node, turning short prompts into 512-token completions.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested line is skipped by the parser and the
# engine then starts without what this file declares. host/port/served-model-name are set
# outside this file.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
attention-backend: flashinfer
cuda-graph-max-bs: 1
enable-torch-compile: true
